<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Beam tip oscillates 40<->46 (RIGHT +6, ACTION7 -6). Target cols 42-45: tip 40=before, 46=past.
# Try MOUSE on beam tip (row 20, col 46) to see if it "fires"/collects.
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':20,'col':46}])
print("after MOUSE(20,46):", {k:r.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','done','level_completed','game_over','reward')})
# report beam tip + red target presence
def tip(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); mx=15
    for rr in (20,21):
        for c in range(16,47):
            if a[rr][c] in 'wg': mx=max(mx,c)
    return mx
seg=current_frame.segmentation
red=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='R']
print("tip:",tip(current_frame)," red nodes:",[(n['pixels'],n['boundary']) for n in red])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def tip(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); mx=15
    for rr in (20,21):
        for c in range(16,47):
            if a[rr][c] in 'wg': mx=max(mx,c)
    return mx
